children: Ventas appointed Laurida Sayed as Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Controller, effective on or around October 5, 2026, relieving Robert F. Probst of interim Chief Accounting Officer duties while he remains CFO.
Senior Vice President, Chief Accounting Officer and Controller
Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer (will remain CFO)
Role change (no longer performing interim Chief Accounting Officer duties)
Ms. Sayed's appointment relieves Mr. Probst of interim CAO responsibilities
Interim CAO responsibilities transferred to Laurida Sayed

Age 44; Chief Accounting Officer of Cushman & Wakefield Ltd. since May 2024; prior roles at Cushman & Wakefield include SVP, Global Corporate Controller (Oct 2022–May 2024) and VP, Assistant Global Controller & Global Finance Transformation (Aug 2019–Oct 2022); BBA in Accounting from Grand Valley State University; CPA.
Will remain as the Company's Chief Financial Officer; was performing CAO duties on an interim basis prior to appointment.
